summary: The next generation of Microsoft AI (MAI) coding models has arrived in GitHub Copilot. Introducing MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash , two new models that represent a major step forward for the MAI-Code family, expanding from lightweight coding assistance to complex, agentic software engineering.
takeaways: Both models are designed for agentic coding workflows, giving developers more flexibility to choose the model that best fits their task.
For more details, see Models and pricing for GitHub Copilot .

Availability in GitHub Copilot MAI Code 2: Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise MAI Code 2 Flash: Copilot Free, Student, Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise Both models are available to eligible GitHub Copilot subscribers on annual plans.
